answer: Random mutual audit stops sybil rings grading themselves. Five outside auditors check one job per epoch; fakes cannot grade each other. Every identity locks a 60-credit bond; two bad audits slash it to its nadir, frozen 20 epochs. A ring is an island: no outside edges, so an 80% overlap cluster freezes. 100 fakes risk 6,000 credits; one honest identity pays 60 once, refunded after 10 epochs, earning full rewards, its record opens like a lotus.
